description: Listening health, detection activity and container resources for an AvianVisitors box.

panels.description: Seconds since the newest detection was written. Climbing past a quiet night means detection has stopped.
panels.title: Detection lag

panels.description: Recorded wav segments waiting for the analyser. A number that climbs and never drains means the box cannot keep up with the mic.
panels.title: Backlog

panels.description: Supervised services reporting as not running.
panels.title: Services down

panels.description: Whether the detections database is present and readable.
panels.title: Database

panels.description: A write probe against the data volume. Zero means the filesystem went read-only, which stops detections without raising an error anywhere else.
panels.title: Data volume

panels.description: Distinct species ever detected on this box.
panels.title: Life list

panels.description: Distinct species heard in the last 24 hours.
panels.title: Species today

panels.description: Detections written in the last 24 hours.
panels.title: Detections today

panels.description: Wall clock time of the most recent call.
panels.title: Last detection

panels.description: The oldest detection on record, so how long this box has been listening.
panels.title: Listening since

panels.description: Calls per hour for the ten busiest species. The dawn chorus shows up here as a wall every morning.
panels.title: Calls per hour by species

panels.description: Lifetime detection counts, busiest species first.
panels.title: Top species

panels.description: How confident the model is across all detections. A mass hugging the cutoff means the confidence threshold is doing most of the work.
panels.title: Detection confidence distribution

panels.description: Median and 90th percentile confidence, with the running mean derived from the histogram sum and count.
panels.title: Confidence quantiles

panels.description: Segments waiting for the analyser, and how much disk that backlog is holding.
panels.title: Analysis backlog

panels.description: Ages around the pipeline. The newest segment ageing means the recorder stopped writing; the oldest ageing means the analyser is behind; the marker ageing means one file is stuck.
panels.title: Pipeline ages

panels.description: Supervised services as reported by supervisorctl.
panels.title: Service state

panels.description: How long each service has been up. A sawtooth is a crash loop, and on the recorder it usually means the mic keeps dropping out.
panels.title: Service uptime

panels.description: CPU burned per service. The analyser is the one that matters on a Pi.
panels.title: Service CPU

panels.description: Resident memory per service.
panels.title: Service memory

panels.description: Memory charged to the container cgroup, with its peak and, when one is set, its limit.
panels.title: Container memory

panels.description: CPU used by everything in the container, in cores.
panels.title: Container CPU

panels.description: Time the container spent held back by its CPU quota, and how often that happened. Rising here is the usual cause behind a growing analysis backlog.
panels.title: CPU throttling

panels.description: Processes inside the container cgroup.
panels.title: Container processes

panels.description: Free and total space on the data volume.
panels.title: Data volume space

panels.description: Share of the data volume in use.
panels.title: Data volume used

panels.description: Size of the detections database. It only ever grows, so the slope is roughly how busy the site is.
panels.title: Database size

panels.description: How long the exporter itself takes. It runs a handful of queries and stats per scrape, so this should stay in the low milliseconds.
panels.title: Scrape duration

panels.description: Files under /data/metrics the exporter could not read this scrape. Anything above zero means a textfile producer is writing metrics nobody is collecting.
panels.title: Textfile collector errors

title: AvianVisitors
